name: Lavender
author: Izumi
description: A phone-first Material look: a periwinkle accent on soft violet-black, large rounded corners and tonal buttons. The bottom bar is an 80dp Material navigation bar with a tonal pill behind the active icon and labels on every tab; the featured pager uses centred Material dots; rows end in an arrow; the series page uses underlined tabs over a thumbnail episode list. Desktop keeps the palette with a wider banner.
